zh_CN.title: 糖果连线
zh_CN.rankRules: 前 50 名：先比通关数，再比各关最佳分数之和。同分按社区用户 ID 排序。仅社区排位成绩上榜。
zh_CN.rankStartHint: 开始排位会新开所选关卡。排位关卡按已提交的成绩解锁；完成后点击提交成绩。重玩本关或顶部切关会回到练习模式。
zh_CN.rankMine: 我的名次 #{rank} · 已过 {completed}/7 关 · 总分 {score}
zh_CN.rankNotListed: 尚未上榜，完成一关社区排位并提交即可参与。
zh_CN.rankUnavailable: 当前未接入社区排行，或未获准网络/用户权限。可以继续练习。
zh_CN.rankReady: 可刷新社区榜单或开始排位。
zh_CN.rankStarted: 排位已开始，2 小时内完成并提交。
zh_CN.rankPending: 有通关成绩待提交，点击“提交 / 重试成绩”参与排名。
zh_CN.rankSubmitted: 成绩验证通过，正式排行榜已更新。
zh_CN.rankSubmittedSandbox: 成绩验证通过，已更新沙箱测试榜。
zh_CN.rankSandbox: 沙箱测试榜 · 与正式榜单隔离
zh_CN.rankRequestFailed: 排行榜暂不可用，请稍后重试；未提交的成绩已保留。
zh_CN.rankAuthError: 社区授权失效或权限不足，请重新打开应用后重试。
zh_CN.rankRateLimit: 操作较频繁，请稍后再试。
zh_CN.rankExpired: 排位已过期或已被新对局替代，可放弃待提交成绩后重新开始。
zh_CN.rankLocked: 该排位关卡尚未解锁，请刷新榜单并先提交前一关。
zh_CN.modePractice: 练习模式 · 本局不计入社区排行
zh_CN.modeRanked: 社区排位 · 通关后在排行榜中提交成绩
zh_CN.tagline: 收集目标糖果，挑战七个关卡。
zh_CN.help: 点击两个相邻糖果交换，凑成三连。
zh_CN.levelInstruction: 集齐全部目标即可过关
zh_CN.levelCleared: 第 {level} 关 · 已通关，可重玩
zh_CN.campaignWinCopy: 所有颜色目标都已完成！可以选择任意关卡，再挑战更高分。
zh_CN.legacyRestored: 已保留原棋盘和道具，从第 1 关开始收集挑战。
zh_CN.specialHelp: 四连或更多，随机获得特殊糖果。点击使用消耗 1 步，连锁引爆不额外扣步。
zh_CN.specialTap: 点击引爆 · 消耗 1 步
zh_CN.specialEarned: 获得：{types}！特殊糖果可点击引爆或连锁触发。
zh_CN.identity: 社区身份由 SDK 提供
zh_CN.winCopy: 所有颜色目标已集齐，第 {level} 关已解锁。
zh_CN.overCopy: 还有目标糖果没有收集完。利用道具和连消，再试一次！
zh_CN.pausedText: 准备好后继续收集糖果。
zh_CN.restored: 已恢复关卡、收集进度和道具。
zh_CN.preview: 本地预览 · 未连接社区，进度和得分仅保留在本页
zh_CN.guest: 访客模式 · 未授权能力不会调用
zh_CN.connected: 已连接社区 · 数据按应用与用户隔离
zh_CN.disconnected: 社区连接不可用 · 仍可在本页游玩
zh_CN.apiError: 社区功能暂不可用（{code}），游戏可继续
zh_CN.saveUnreadable: 无法读取旧存档，已开始新游戏。
zh_CN.invalidMove: 这两个糖果暂时不能交换。
zh_CN.reshuffled: 没有可用交换，棋盘已重新洗牌。

en.rankRules: Top 50: completed levels first, then the sum of each level's best score. Ties use community user ID. Ranked runs only.
en.rankStartHint: Starts a fresh board. Ranked levels unlock through submitted wins. Submit after clearing a level. Retry level or the top level selector returns to practice.
en.rankNotListed: Not ranked yet. Clear and submit a ranked level to join.
en.rankUnavailable: Ranking is not connected or network/user permission is unavailable. Practice is still available.
en.rankReady: Refresh the board or start a ranked run.
en.rankStarted: Ranked run started. Complete and submit within 2 hours.
en.rankPending: A completed run is waiting. Use Submit / retry result to join the ranking.
en.rankSubmitted: Verified! The community leaderboard is updated.
en.rankSubmittedSandbox: Verified! The sandbox test board is updated.
en.rankSandbox: Sandbox test board · Separate from production
en.rankRequestFailed: Ranking is unavailable. Please retry later; your pending result is kept.
en.rankAuthError: Authorization expired or permission denied. Reopen the app and retry.
en.rankRateLimit: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
en.rankExpired: Run expired or replaced. Discard the pending result to start again.
en.rankLocked: Ranked level is locked. Refresh and submit the previous level first.
en.modePractice: Practice · This game is not ranked
en.modeRanked: Ranked run · Submit in the leaderboard after clearing
en.title: Candy Cascade
en.tagline: Collect target candies across seven levels.
en.help: Click two adjacent candies to swap and match three.
en.campaignWinCopy: Every color target collected! Pick any level to replay and beat your score.
en.legacyRestored: Your board and specials are kept. Start collecting in level 1.
en.specialHelp: Match 4+ to earn a random special candy. Tap to use 1 move; chain blasts cost no extra moves.
en.specialEarned: Earned: {types}! Tap special candies or hit them in a chain.
en.winCopy: All color targets collected. Level {level} is unlocked.
en.overCopy: Some targets are still missing. Try using specials and cascades!
en.restored: Level, collection progress and specials restored.
en.preview: Local preview · No community connection. Scores and progress stay on this page.
en.guest: Guest session · Only granted capabilities are used.
en.connected: Connected to the community · Data belongs to this app and user.
en.disconnected: Community unavailable · You can keep playing on this page.
en.apiError: Community feature unavailable ({code}). You can keep playing.
en.saveUnreadable: The previous save could not be read. A new game has started.
en.invalidMove: Those candies cannot be swapped yet.
en.reshuffled: No swaps were available, so the board was shuffled.
